verdict.rationale: v0 is an AI agent, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. The documented integrations (Supabase, Neon, Upstash, AI model providers) and the general 'favorite tools and APIs' claim are adjacent project-level service integrations, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
